writer_failure_caveat.uncertain_close: If stream.close is interrupted before its raw wrapper is closed, _CloseState retains the stream while KeyStore.close still retires its original numeric descriptor. There is no explicit stream-closed test or coupled raw-FD quarantine in this source.
